reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for reviewing agent file changes through diffs, reverting current-turn changes, and commenting on changed lines for follow-up, so testing-debugging is the closest primary category.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中查看智能体修改的文件差异、撤销当前轮次更改，并通过行评论反馈修改意见。
summaries.en: Review files changed by an agent in DeepSeek Harness Web, inspect diffs, undo current-turn changes, and leave line comments for follow-up.

capabilities: Displays diffs for files changed by an agent
Reverts an agent's changes from the current turn
Adds comments to changed lines for agent follow-up
Provides Chinese and English interface support
